chapter: Union, Emmett Hardy and Rampart Street Parade
title: Emmett Hardy's drive and his time with the New Orleans Rhythm Kings
summary: He compares Hardy's drive to Bix's and discusses whether Hardy and Paul Mares were in the Rhythm Kings together.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players
